batch: P3 fixed-peer bounded Listener/Serve admission, two-phase TCP/TLS handshake, election and shutdown ownership
status_meaning: Only this bounded twelfth implementation batch; multi-peer admission, full Peer events/contexts/identifiers, four-application definitions and Ro/RO-06, SCTP and v1 remain incomplete
environment_note: Go checks use writable /tmp GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE, GOWORK=off, GOTOOLCHAIN=local and GOPROXY=off. Network tests require local loopback permission, with no external-service access or skipped socket tests. Release paths use CGO=0; race instrumentation is run separately.
implemented: retained owned Base/S6c normal/E codec; ops3 extracts Destination presence and values for fixed runtime binding
bounded Node-owned completion ports and atomic Node/class/Peer/Port reservation accounting
single-attempt Submit/Request, immutable snapshots, per-connection pending and first-winner completion
prefix-first receive classification, bounded unmatched discard and pre-body matched-answer size rejection
BeginWrite and borrower barriers preserve partial/uncertain/full write evidence through Cancel/Close
initiator/responder CER/CEA, CEA write barrier, watchdog and explicit-reconnect REOPEN, remote DPR/DPA closing
BootID identities, non-reusing per-connection HBH and one-cycle application/control E2E half-spaces
retained fake stream transport and 22 earlier runtime test groups plus budget tests
Peer/Node Shutdown: permanent Draining, admitted-write drain exception, one shortening total deadline and immediate Close upgrade
local DPR and independent DPA correlation, normal/E fast DPA closure, crossed/duplicate control handling and partial-frame close barriers
two fixed physical candidate slots, validated identity election, passive EOF/promotion and shared handshake deadline without open replacement
prefix-read handover and candidate retirement after I/O exit; Shutdown bounded return remains separate from Wait cleanup and completion-port consumption
12 new shutdown test groups and 7 election groups; full tests/race and 20 repeated root race runs passed
transport/tcp.New and transport/tls.Client/Server take exclusive established TCP socket ownership; TLS handshake has explicit finite timeout
shared internal stream cursor uses 20-byte prefix and 256-byte discard scratch, caller-owned frame destination and separate read/write deadline scopes
first-byte absolute frame deadline carries through body/discard; cancellation update and callback retirement prevent stale deadline contamination
TCP exact accepted-byte and TLS conservative uncertain-error evidence; idempotent underlying socket Close unblocks I/O without waiting for close_notify
TLS 1.2/1.3 mutual certificate verification, explicit configuration, failure closes, negotiated state exposed without raw socket access
fixed 4096-byte logical adapter reserve excludes standard-library TLS/net, certificate/cache and kernel memory; admission rejects insufficient configured reserve before CER
Node caller deadline forwarding fixed so timer races cannot relabel handshake DeadlineExceeded as Canceled
17 new real-loopback test groups include Base/S6c flow, cancel/late answer, election and crossed shutdown; all checks plus 20 repeated root race runs passed
explicit no-cache InboundPolicy, finite terminal Origin allowlist and local destination binding; no adjacency-implies-authority shortcut
Peer.Receive and Inbound.Message/Info/Done/Respond; separate mutable application view and private request envelope evidence
independent InboundClasses hard partition plus Node/Peer constraints; reserve request/response workspace before body receive, no unbudgeted rejection queue
single response preparer and one-time commit, pre-commit validation/cancel retry, post-commit bounded write settlement with actual delivery evidence
bounded per-peer receive and per-connection answer queues; shared reader/writer and frame-level answer/request alternation, Base control remains independently reserved
execution expiry, disconnected logical work, old-arrival isolation, Draining responses and Closing suppression; Node.Wait retains preparation/write borrower barriers
17 new Inbound groups validate S6c success/normal failure/experimental failure/E, Base control isolation, no-cache duplicates, budgets, close/cancel and reconnect over real TCP/TLS
opt-in compiled BaseErrorFailures and named Inbound.Reject; shared Respond preparation and one-time commit, default policy preserves close/terminate behavior
bounded trusted Session/Proxy extraction; 3001/3007 unknown command/application, project binding-denial 3002, explicit-local-host-only 3004 and local processing 5012
5005 automatic placeholders for five top-level Base required leaves; untrusted/duplicate Session or invalid Proxy and unmapped failures close without truncation or repair
fixed global emergency RX/TX slots charged once in TransportReserve, reserved after prefix before body, separate activity snapshot and bounded answer queues
prebuilt execution-timeout answer under admitted I/W; timer performs only state/queue operations, manual/automatic decisions and Close share borrower barriers
settled writes no longer remain on the timer while a losing application preparer retains the charge; invalid/overloaded requests cannot bypass source/destination checks
19 new Reject test groups over real TCP/TLS; full CGO=0 tests/vet/build, full race, generation and dependency checks, and 20 repeated root race runs passed
ops4 / Profile slice.4: generated raw-request CanonicalV1 operations and public codec.Canonical; no new wire commands or fields
length-prefixed exact comparison: ASCII identities, stable top-level independent keys, unknown barriers, ordered repeats/groups, effective flags/padding and fixed SMS VSAI ignore scope
explicit DuplicatePolicy and independent DuplicateClasses C reservation before business delivery; Node/Origin/E2E lookup including T=0, no peer/command-based identity splitting
atomic Processing insertion, content/finite-policy conflicts return arrival-specific E/5012 without replacing or refreshing the original record; bounded conflict counter
one logical Inbound across bounded arrivals, each with own I/W, header and proxy chain; validated immutable result template excludes first-hop Proxy/header
completed normal/experimental/E results and deadline failure replay, disconnected primary and multi-peer handling, REOPEN requires new actual arrival before replay
fixed execution/retention deadlines, no LRU eviction, expiry stops reuse while borrowers hold C; close/suppression does not create new business delivery
replay assembly and full codec validation outside state lock, pre-I/O Closing/deadline recheck, actual write evidence and C/I/W last-reference barriers
21 new root test groups; full CGO=0 checks and race, 20 repeated root race runs, 10-second Canonical fuzz with 668219 executions, generator/dependency audits passed
ops5 / Profile slice.5: explicit audited TransportReplay permission, included in frozen Bundle fingerprint; only ordinary SRR enabled, no new wire commands or fields
Node.NewRoute with finite ordered peers, explicit SingleAttempt/TransportFailover/ExplicitRetransmit modes, same-terminal bindings, declared replay retention, fixed deadline and bounded attempts
one logical RequestID/completion with independent per-attempt pending, header, source policy, receiving state and upfront answer reservation; Peer.Submit remains SingleAttempt
original immutable body/Origin/Destination/Session/E2E retained; per-connection HBH and T derived from actual preceding write evidence after all prior writers exit
automatic recovery only for recognized I/O transport errors or watchdog Suspect; protocol/local errors, deadlines, cancellation and valid normal/E answers terminate without retry
RequestInfo owned active summary and idempotent Retransmit(after) edge; no-ready/budget refusal leaves Awaiting at original deadline; single-peer new-generation REOPEN supported
old-connection late answers compete at the same completion gate; all writer/reader borrowers settle before publication and aggregate attempt evidence cannot erase earlier delivery risk

global Node/class/port reservation includes N answer slots once, per-Peer windows charged separately without double Node accounting; retired attempts release connection references and retain bounded summaries
23 new root Route groups plus schema/generator permission validation; all pure-Go checks, full race and 20 root race repeats passed
public transport.Dialer with predeclared adapter bound, Node.Dial and TCP/TLS fixed-endpoint Dialer constructors; no internal business retry or discovery
pre-dial outbound slot/ConnectionID admission and Node task ownership; transport/TLS/CER/election share one absolute Handshake deadline, including late returns and error-with-Conn ownership
WaitConnAck/WaitConnAckElect integrate pending transport with existing two-direction election; failed active promotion, passive winner and third-candidate rejection retain I/O retirement barriers
explicit per-Peer MaintainPolicy and single blocking manager; fixed exponential backoff cap/nonnegative jitter, saturating failure count and continuous Okay stable-period reset
network/watchdog failure reconnect, protocol/certificate/config/resource suppression, DPR REBOOTING retry versus BUSY/DO_NOT_WANT suppression; passive acceptance does not clear suppression
Maintain cancellation closes its management domain without permanently closing Peer; Node/Peer Shutdown instead retains drain/DPR ownership; Peer.Wait covers callbacks and connection borrowers
one fixed 4096-byte per-Peer management reserve in TransportReserve; one outbound candidate, one passive candidate and one manager with reusable timer, no per-request worker or retry history

reconnected generations remain REOPEN until three matched DWAs; old SingleAttempt never replays and ExplicitRetransmit stays Awaiting until application calls Retransmit; manager cancellation never triggers Route failover
24 new Dial/Maintain test groups over fake and real TCP/TLS; final test/check results are recorded below
Frozen SchedulerConfig and owned expanded SchedulerInfo: default 16 KiB, category 4:2:1, class/emergency 1; bounded positive weights and validated class overrides
Per-physical-connection Control/Answer/Request then request/answer class byte DRR: full encoded frame costs, FIFO, bounded credit, empty-lane visit end and arithmetic empty-round skipping
Independent emergency answer lane; cached multi-arrival responses charged with each arrival proxy bytes; fixed plan/two-candidate schedule reserve with no business quota borrowing

15 new groups cover byte shares/no starvation, oracle comparison, FIFO/refill/cancellation, real TCP/TLS mixed Base/S6c drain/close/deadlines and class slot/byte isolation; prior Route/Maintain/duplicate tests retained
transport.Listener/Incoming two-phase accepted socket and establishment contract; TCP/TLS owned wrappers around pre-bound TCP listeners, context-safe Accept reuse and frozen TLS policy
Fixed-peer Node.Serve, one listener owner per peer, passive candidate reserved before Accept, wait for capacity before another socket, explicit ListenerBytesPerPeer and independent fixed reserve

Idle accept has no handshake deadline or CER election vote; accepted socket TLS/CER/CEA/election share one absolute deadline; passive/active election and Maintain coexistence preserve two-candidate bounds

Serve cancellation closes listener and unfinished candidates, leaving installed connections to Peer/Node; Shutdown retains drain ownership and Wait includes late Accept/Establish/CEA and close callbacks

21 new test groups cover real TCP/TLS service and election, admission/owned error objects/metadata, late callbacks and retained slots, deadline reuse, mTLS and shutdown; all earlier runtime tests retained
